text:
elaine (PM): quick kickoff — we need a compact dependency lattice for the Q3 roadmap so engineering, ml, and platform can sequence milestones. short thread to align on critical path and handoff windows. :spiral_calendar:

matthew (Eng): what are the must-hit launch criteria? latency/cost targets or feature parity?

elaine (PM): prioritized: 1) API feature parity for hosted routing + model variants; 2) p50 latency <120ms for standard token sizes; 3) canary + auto-fallback behavior; 4) private deploy path for pilot customers (opt-in). proposed milestone spine below.

elaine (PM): ```
M1 (infra gating) - infra-quotas + canary env - owner: sophia - target: 2029-11-10
M2 (model variants) - quantization + kernel selection validated - owner: raj - target: 2029-11-24
M3 (api/features) - routing, function-calls, streaming - owner: matthew - target: 2029-12-05
M4 (rollout) - canary + auto-fallback + metrics - owners: eng + platform - target: 2029-12-12
Handoff windows: design -> api by 2029-11-30, sales -> private pilot readiness by 2029-12-08
```

sophia (Eng Platform): infra gating note: kernel/quantization infra needs test harness and GPU quota. gating criterion should be "quant profile validated on benchmark set" not just "deployable". I'll own quota escalation.

raj (ML): ML timeline: 2w for quantization sweep on the reference workloads, then 1w to integrate evaluation harness for regression alerts. we depend on canary infra for full perf tests. blocker: need access to 2xA100 for 3 days for the initial sweep.

camille (Design): design handoff: error/retry UI + fallback UX must be spec'd before canary so PMs can validate customer flows. i'll have mocks by 2029-11-22.

ana (Sales): small correction: BigBank pilot requires private deployment + SLA language in contract. if that goes green, private deploy becomes a hard dependency for their launch. cc @elaine.

matthew (Eng): noted. two immediate blockers: 1) infra quota ticket CLOUD-789 pending approval; 2) dependency on infra to stand up canary k8s-namespace with GPU nodes. i'll raise a formal escalation if CLOUD-789 isn't moved by EOD Fri. :arrow_up:

ops-bot: CLOUD-789 status changed -> "blocked" by cloud-quotas team (automated note).

elaine (PM): action list: - sophia escalate CLOUD-789 and confirm ETA - raj start quant sweep in parallel to infra spin-up where possible - matthew to break down API work into two tracks (core + polish) - camille deliver fallback mocks by 11/22 - ana confirm whether BigBank pilot is commitment or a request by EOD Thu

sophia (Eng Platform): i'll take CLOUD-789. planning to open a support-cc with cloud-sales and request temporary quota increase. proposed parallelism: start canary infra with 1 node GPU and use mocked routing for early perf runs. saves ~1 week.

raj (ML): agree on parallelism. i'll prepare the eval harness to run on smaller instance first, then re-run on full GPU when quota is available.

matthew (Eng): i'll split API into: track A (routing + model selection core) and track B (streaming + function-call polish). track A is on the critical path.

elaine (PM): decision: treat infra quota + track A completion as the critical path. anything that delays those -> escalate. starting daily 15m sync until 2029-11-15. i'll send calendar invite.

ana (Sales): BigBank update: they want pilot week of 2029-12-09. that tightens our rollout window — flagging as potential timeline shift.

matthew (Eng): added a new row in the live lattice sheet: link: https://example.com/sheets/redwood/dep-lattice (please update). I've added a 'risk' column for GPU quota and SLA asks.

camille (Design): noted. will update mocks for the private-flow edge cases after ana confirms pilot commitment.

elaine (PM): final ask: everyone add a single-line ETA and blocking assumptions to the sheet by EOD tomorrow. i'll consolidate and put a decision log entry. thanks all :white_check_mark:

matthew (Eng): done.

raj (ML): added quant sweep ETA and test matrices.

sophia (Eng Platform): escalation submitted to cloud-sales, ticket CLOUD-789-ESC created. ETA from cloud is 72h. will update here.

ops-bot: CLOUD-789-ESC created -> assigned to cloud-sales.
